Assam Startup Ecosystem Shows Growth, High Women Participation

A report on Assam's startup ecosystem indicates robust entrepreneurial participation across various sectors. According to the IIMCIP's Assam Startup Ecosystem Report, 52.6% of surveyed startups were founded by women. However, the report also noted persistent funding gaps and called for increased mentorship, networking opportunities, R&D, and support for startups.
